overall_goal: Whip the coffee paste vigorously in the cups

goals.description: Whip the coffee paste in the first cup
goals.rationale: The person picks up the first cup and vigorously mixes the contents with a spoon to form a coffee paste, returning to it after working on the second cup.

goals.description: Whip the coffee paste in the second cup
goals.rationale: The person picks up the second cup and vigorously mixes its contents with a spoon to form a coffee paste, alternating with the first cup.
